proposed.text: A developer is constructing a 6-storey commercial building in Makati. Each floor plate is 210 sq.m with an occupant load of 25 persons. No sprinkler system is currently planned. Under PD 1096, Rule XII, Sec. 1212, which statement is most accurate?

options.text: No fire-extinguishing system is required because the building is primarily commercial, not residential occupancy
A fire-extinguishing system is required because each floor meets both the 200 sq.m area and the > 20 occupant load thresholds
A fire-extinguishing system is only required at the basement level, not at the upper floors of the building
A fire-extinguishing system is required only if the building exceeds 8 storeys under PD 1096 Rule XII
